set.body: PRD APP-13 and RA-8. Compute available analyses and exact missing prerequisites from Session/project state. Existing cases include missing Viewing or AoiSet. Event-aligned plans additionally require an ObservedTimeline, a MarkSelector resolving under its occurrence policy, and SyncEvidence adequate for the requested clocks/precision. Errors name trial, selector, observed match count, clock operands, and missing schema id/version where applicable.
